content:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a spike in token-level latency for route /chat/stream starting ~0200 UTC. p90 token latency jumped from ~18ms -> ~45ms. Graphs show a correlated drop in prefix cache reuse for that route.

shane: Any recent kernel changes or batching knobs flipped?

maria: No kernel changes in the last deploy window. Runtime build at commit a3f2. The interesting bit is kvcache hit rate for that route dropped from 86% -> 55% at the same time.

eli: Can you paste the prom queries you used?

maria: Sure, grabbing quick ones I ran in Grafana: 
```
rate(prefix_cache.reuse_total{route="/chat/stream"}[5m]) / rate(prefix_cache.request_total{route="/chat/stream"}[5m])
```
and 
```
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```

carla: Could be instrumentation sampling for reuse events. We recently lowered PREFIX_REUSE_SAMPLE_RATE on hosts to 1% to reduce telemetry cost. That would make actual reuse look artificially low for per-route breakdowns.

maria: Good call. I checked the host env and one canary pool was at 0.01. But the production pools are 0.1 — yet the effective reuse drop is across all pools for that route. Weird.

eli: Two hypotheses: 1) real workload change (different prompts, fewer shared prefixes), 2) sampling config bug where route-specific tags were dropped when sample rate < threshold, blowing up per-route denominator.

maria: I profiled a few requests with trace sampling and saw many prefix_reuse events being emitted without route labels at sample rate 0.01. logs: 
```
WARN kv_cache: reuse_event missing route tag, host=redwood-r1
```

shane: Oof. If missing route tags, Prometheus/OTEL will attribute them to unknown or drop, so route-level hit rates will be wrong. That matches symptoms.

carla: Quick mitigation: bump sampling to 100% for prefix_reuse on the busiest hosts for 1 hour and re-evaluate. Also add a temporary Grafana panel for untagged reuse events: 
```
sum(rate(prefix_cache.reuse_total{route=""}[5m]))
```

maria: I can patch the config. Plan: increase PREFIX_REUSE_SAMPLE_RATE=1.0 on pool-r1-r13 for 1 hour, collect data, then revert. Will also force route tag enrichment in the emitter.

ops-bot: @maria set PREFIX_REUSE_SAMPLE_RATE -> 1.0 on pool-r1-r13 (in progress) :gear:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-18T02:12: rolling out instrumentation fix to emitter service (canary=5%).

eli: While that's rolling, let's check kernel selection counts — if cache reuse drops, batching might change and kernel heuristics might choose different GEMM kernels causing latency shift. Query: 
```
sum(rate(kernel_selection_total{kernel!="none",route="/chat/stream"}[5m])) by (kernel)
```

maria: Kernel mix hasn't changed significantly. It's still dominated by fast-float16 kernels. So this looks like a cache visibility / sampling issue primarily.

carla: For the emitter fix, here's the one-line patch I used locally to preserve tags even when sampling: 
```
if sampled_event: emit_with_tags(event, tags)
else: emit_summary(event_type, route=tags.get('route','unknown'))
```

shane: Can we also add a short-term dashboard with per-route memory footprint and eviction rate? Useful to confirm whether evictions increased for that route. Suggested panels: prefix_cache.memory_bytes_by_route, prefix_cache.evictions_rate_by_route.

maria: Adding panels now. Also starting a high-res profile for a couple of affected requests (kv cache instrumentation + kernel timers).

ops-bot: @maria PREFIX_REUSE_SAMPLE_RATE change completed on pool-r1-r13.

maria: Data coming in — untagged reuse events dropped to near zero after deploy and route-tagged reuse increased back toward prior levels. p90 token latency trending down already (from 45ms -> 22ms).

eli: Nice. We should: 1) roll the emitter tag-preservation patch to all regions, 2) temporarily raise sampling to 100% for 1 hour during the roll so dashboards stay accurate, 3) add a unit test to ensure route tag survives sampling codepaths.

carla: I'll open a small CL for the emitter and add the test. Also propose an ops alert: prefix_cache.untagged_events_rate > 10/min triggers a pager to infra oncall.

shane: Agree. Also add a derived metric: prefix_cache.estimated_effective_hit_rate which uses global counts to sanity-check per-route numbers.

maria: Action items: 
- maria: finish high-res traces and attach sample payloads to the ticket (ETA 2h)
- carla: CL + test for emitter (ETA 4h)
- shane: dashboard panels + derived metric alert (ETA 3h)
- eli: verify canary kernels unaffected and sign off on emitter roll (ETA 2h)

deploy-bot: Note: instrumentation canary rolled to 20% at 2026-03-18T02:28.

maria: Thanks all — so far this looks like an instrumentation sampling/tagging bug causing an apparent per-route cache recession and a downstream latency regression. Will update ticket once traces uploaded. :thumbsup:
